units.text: LibreEvolve is an open-source workbench for inspectable code-evolution experiments. Its engineering preview explores changes to a small Python bin-packing heuristic through bounded local optimization with Codex OAuth. Inspect saved results and export a candidate after fresh training and held-out checks. No improvement is a valid outcome.
units.usage_condition: Use only with the current engineering-preview qualifier and a verified destination where applicable.

units.text: LibreEvolve makes a small code-evolution experiment inspectable. The engineering preview starts with a Python bin-packing heuristic, explores changes through bounded local Codex OAuth work, and records candidate workspaces and evaluation evidence. Saved results separate candidate validity, training quality, held-out quality, run completion and reported usage. Export checks a chosen candidate again on named finite cases and records its identity. Those checks do not establish universal performance or optimality, and no improvement remains a valid outcome. Candidate execution has host access rather than a security sandbox. Usage can be incomplete; local limits are not billing guarantees. Begin with the offline setup path and review the limits before authorizing a live optimization run.
units.usage_condition: Use only with the current engineering-preview qualifier and a verified destination where applicable.

units.text: Run status
units.usage_condition: Label the local runtime status; never infer candidate validity from completion.

units.text: Training quality
units.usage_condition: Show the named split and definition; do not convert quality to accuracy or speed.

units.text: Held-out quality
units.usage_condition: Keep separate from training; display only actual named held-out checks.

units.text: Named checks
units.usage_condition: Pair with explicit pass/fail/unknown state and corpus identity.

units.text: No improvement verified. Inspect the separate checks and the search outcome.
units.usage_condition: Use when the relevant valid same-corpus comparison establishes no improvement; otherwise use an unverified or incomplete outcome.

units.text: Fewer bins on this checked split.
units.usage_condition: Use only when both baseline and candidate are valid on identical cases in this split and candidate total bins is strictly lower. Do not imply held-out or general improvement.

units.text: More bins on this checked split.
units.usage_condition: Use only when both solutions are valid on identical cases in this split and candidate total bins is strictly higher.

units.text: Selected source is unchanged from the seed.
units.usage_condition: Use only when the selected source bytes match the named seed; unchanged quality alone does not establish unchanged source.

units.text: Candidate failed the named checks. Bin placeholders are not a result to compare.
units.usage_condition: Use for an observed invalid result; unknown or missing validity must use unverified wording.

units.text: Run incomplete. Available artifacts do not establish a completed result.
units.usage_condition: Use for incomplete or interrupted runtime/artifacts, retaining any separately verified candidate evidence.

units.text: Local run cancelled. Saved state may be partial; remote cancellation is not confirmed.
units.usage_condition: Use only for recorded local cancellation; do not infer that provider work or billing stopped.

units.text: Usage incomplete or unknown. Missing cost information does not mean zero cost.
units.usage_condition: Use when the usage ledger or provider cost/quota information is incomplete or unavailable.

units.text: No comparable result verified.
units.usage_condition: Use when required validity, same-corpus provenance or comparison data is absent or inconsistent.

units.text: Export freshly checks the chosen candidate on named training and held-out cases. The recorded hash identifies source bytes, not universal correctness or independent certification.
units.usage_condition: Use only with the current engineering-preview qualifier and a verified destination where applicable.
